 News Flash
 City of Norfolk Offices Closed for Election Day
 News, Home page
 Posted on October 27, 2026 
 NORFOLK, Va. – The City of Norfolk’s offices, including libraries, The Slover, recreation centers, Norfolk Animal Care Center, Commissioner of the Revenue, City Treasurer and the Norfolk Courthouse will be closed on Tuesday, Nov. 3, for Election Day. Offices will reopen at regular business hours on Wednesday, Nov. 4. 
 Trash, recycling and bulk waste collection will take place as scheduled on Nov. 3. Bulk item pickup requests for Nov. 3 and Nov. 4 must be scheduled by 3 p.m. on Monday, Nov. 2. Use the MyNorfolk mobile app, online portal or call Norfolk Cares at (757) 664-6510 to request a bulk waste collection. 
 Street sweeping for Nov. 3 has been moved to Nov. 2. Residents are reminded to move vehicle(s) from the right-of-way so sweepers can get all the way to the curbline. 
 For more information on voting, elections, sample ballots, polling locations and election results, visit www.norfolk.gov/elections .
